project.location: Plot Nos. 401, 402, 415-438, Swami Vivekanand Road, Santacruz West / Andheri, Mumbai

oc_status.note: Project proposed completion 31.12.2022, revised proposed completion 30.12.2024. Construction stalled at plinth level only; no work for past 4 years due to pending litigation and financial-institution disputes; respondents facing criminal fraud/cheating actions.

amount.interest_rate_description: Interest from 01.01.2021 as prescribed under RERA; rate not restated in the Final Order paragraph itself

options.event: OC being received for the said Project

installments.note: Total accrued refund + interest payable in 3 equal monthly instalments once the earlier-of trigger is reached; if OC delayed beyond 30.12.2024, further interest accrues and is payable every month on the 5th until possession with OC. Subject to deduction of COVID moratorium period per MahaRERA Orders 13/14/21.

reliefs.reasoning: Complainant booked 2 flats (805, 806) under a term sheet dated 22.12.2017 with possession promised 31.12.2020; that date passed without possession or an agreement for sale. Respondent had already refunded ~Rs. 1.99 crore but remained in default on the balance. Complainant purchased two flats with combined amounts paid of Rs. 4,48,00,000 and Rs. 25,97,000 respectively — order does not total these, so a single value is not recorded here.

reliefs.reasoning: Booked under a subvention scheme in 2017 (5% upfront, rest on fit-out possession) with possession promised December 2019; bank (Respondent No.4, not a party here) disbursed the balance loan to the promoter disproportionate to actual progress. Only the refund of Rs. 63,50,410 paid to Respondent No.1 is captured here; a further Rs. 6,18,81,990 the order directs be refunded to the financing bank is excluded as it is not an amount owed to the buyer.

Complainant wants to stay in the project, not exit. No agreement for sale executed despite respondent accepting >10% of consideration (Section 13 violation). No document showed a specific possession date, so the Authority used the RERA-registered completion date (30.12.2024) — that date had not yet arrived, so this counts as premature.
Possession date used (RERA completion date 30.12.2024) had not yet arrived at the time of this order; Section 18 delay-interest relief held premature.
Same basis as CC006000000196158 (Sr. No. 4) — wants to stay in the project; no possession date document uploaded, RERA completion date (30.12.2024) used and not yet arrived.
Same basis as CC006000000196158 (Sr. No. 4) — premature, RERA completion date not yet arrived.

reliefs.reasoning: MOU dated 30.01.2016 for 3 flats (Rs. 62.1 crore total), possession due 30.08.2019 (3 years 4 months + 3 months grace) per the MOU; that date passed with no delivery. Authority held the MOU validly rescinded.

Complainant does not intend to withdraw and wants the project completed. Booking form dated 21.09.2016 states possession by 31.12.2023 — not yet arrived as of this order, so treated the same as Sr. Nos. 4 & 5.
Possession date (31.12.2023 per booking form) had not yet arrived; Section 18 delay-interest relief held premature.

order_level_penalty.reason: Respondents accepted more than 10% of consideration from each complainant without executing agreements for sale, in violation of Section 13; penalty imposed under Section 63.

extraction_notes: None of the 3 respondents appeared at any hearing; all matters proceeded ex-parte and no written submissions were filed despite time being given. The Final Order paragraph directing refund+interest for Sr. Nos. 1-3, 6-8 & 10 does not restate an interest rate -- interest_rate_description on those reliefs is inferred as 'as prescribed under RERA' rather than a specific figure, since the order text itself doesn't repeat one at that point (unlike the Modi order, which names MCLR+2% explicitly). Sr. No. 1's combined two-flat payment amount was left as amount.value: null rather than summed, since the order does not total it either.
